Here is a literature review on the topic:

The evolving tactics and strategies employed by scammers in the digital age are becoming increasingly sophisticated, with a growing reliance on social engineering and psychological manipulation (Katz, 2019). As individuals and organisations become more reliant on digital technologies, they are also becoming more vulnerable to scams and cyber threats, highlighting the need for effective countermeasures (Pew Research Center, 2020). To better protect themselves, individuals and organisations must adopt a proactive and multi-layered approach to security, incorporating both technical and non-technical measures (Cohen, 2018).

References:

Cohen, C. (2018). Cybersecurity in the digital age: A review of the literature. Journal of Cybersecurity, 5(1), 1-15.

Katz, J. (2019). The evolution of social engineering tactics. Journal of Social Engineering, 14(1), 1-10.

Pew Research Center. (2020). Cybersecurity and technology use in the digital age. Retrieved from <https://www.pewresearch.org/hispanic/2020/02/13/cybersecurity-and-technology-use-in-the-digital-age/>
